original_prompt:
@autopilot Make all non-dashboard public pages share a unified, consistent layout. Redesign the navigation bar and footer to match across every public-facing page, then apply this same navigation and footer to all non-dashboard pages so the experience feels cohesive and unified throughout the site.

Redesign the navigation bar with the following centered navigation links in this exact order: FEATURES, PRICING, PROP FIRMS, DEALS, LEADERBOARD, TEAMS, BLOG, SUPPORT. The links should be horizontally centered in the navbar between the logo on the left and any right-side actions. Style them with consistent spacing, uppercase text, clear hover states, and focus-visible outlines for accessibility. Ensure the mobile hamburger menu includes all the same links.

Redesign the footer with the following structure and link groups organized into columns:

PRODUCT column: Features, Pricing, Prop Firms, Deals, Teams

SUPPORT column: Support, Community, Roadmap, FAQ

LEGAL column: About, Privacy, Terms, Disclaimers

Each column should have a bold uppercase heading followed by the links listed vertically. Add the logo and any copyright or branding text at the bottom or top of the footer as appropriate.

After implementing the navigation and footer, update all non-dashboard page layouts to use this same shared navigation and footer so every public page has a unified look and feel. Ensure the navigation links route to the correct existing pages or placeholder routes if a page does not yet exist. Preserve all existing functionality, data fetching, routing, and interactive features. Verify the project builds with no errors.
